entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Blue-aligned human ethnic group on the Quicksilver Sea of Mirrodin who prized knowledge.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metal plane where the Neurok lived.

entities.name: Vedalken Empire
entities.description: Empire that held the Neurok in subservience.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: Vedalken brain trust that claimed all the serum.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Planar caretaker who destroyed the Neurok settlement of Medev.

entities.name: Medev
entities.description: Prominent Neurok settlement destroyed by Memnarch.

entities.name: Networks
entities.description: Secret Neurok sects of assassins and thieves undermining the Vedalken.

entities.name: Litera Phials
entities.description: Vials of quicksilver forming symbols and libraries of knowledge.

entities.name: Battle of the Synod
entities.description: Battle in which the Neurok struck a blow against the Vedalken of Lumengrid.

events.summary: Memnarch destroys the Neurok settlement of Medev.
events.quote: Medev was a prominent Neurok settlement until its destruction by the planar caretaker Memnarch .

events.summary: After the Vanishing, the Synod claims all serum and the Neurok form secret networks to undermine the Vedalken.
events.quote: They began to form secret sects to undermine the Vedalken.

events.summary: The Neurok use the Litera Phials to learn how to destroy vedalken drones.
events.quote: even learning the secret to destroy a key vedalken weapon

events.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok power down the vedalken drones and defeat the Synod.
events.quote: The Synod was defeated, but hundreds died on both sides.

events.summary: Neurok and Vedalken leaders agree to an uneasy truce.
events.quote: Leaders between the Neurok and the Vedalken reached an uneasy truce.

relations.note: Lived in subservience before the networks.
relations.quote: Many Neuroks used to live in a state of subservience to the Vedalken Empire
the Covalt network (led by Vy Covalt )
the Vrist network (led by Kara Vrist )
until its destruction by the planar caretaker Memnarch
